title: The Road to Malopasso
invitation: You've had a taste of the basics. Grim Fronteira is even more fun with other players: turn Scum against your rivals, use your faction's full power, and try Azzardo and Dark mode. Gather your posse and play multiplayer!

gun.title: A gun before sundown
passages: Opossum took everything except your name. A Creole fighter with a rusty machete and a face that looks like a bad mistake, he is a poor man to follow unarmed. Behind a dusty counter, a trader rests one hand on an old revolver. Convince them to sell it.
The trader has heard your offer. This time, explain why leaving you unarmed would be bad for business.
The trader turns the revolver beneath the lamplight. Make one more offer before the shutters close.

outcomes.success: The trader takes your money and slides the revolver across the counter. You leave armed, with questions to ask.
outcomes.failure: The trader shakes their head. The gun stays on the counter. Find another way to persuade them.
outcomes.bust: A hand reaches for the trigger. You wrestle the gun away, but the struggle leaves you bleeding. You have your weapon, and your first scar.

gun.fatal_outcome: The trader's hand closes over the revolver. In the struggle, the gun goes off between you. You fall against the counter, then slide into the dust. The weapon you came to buy is the last thing you hear.

witnesses.title: Loose tongues
passages: At the water queue, faces turn away when you mention Opossum. Apparently a machete leaves a lasting impression. Someone here knows where he went. Ask the right questions.
A mule driver waits outside the cantina. Perhaps a different witness will have fewer reasons to keep quiet.
An old woman watches the northern road. Ask what she saw, and listen before you speak again.

outcomes.success: A mule driver finally speaks: Opossum used the old customs house outside Malopasso as a hideout. He left in a hurry. Whatever he forgot might tell you where he went.
outcomes.failure: A shrug, a lie, a closing door. You learn nothing useful. Try somebody else.
outcomes.bust: Someone calls you Opossum's accomplice. The crowd surges, and you escape through a broken fence with a wound. Behind you, the mule driver shouts, 'Try his old customs-house hideout! And stay away from us!' A painful way to get directions.

witnesses.fatal_outcome: The cry of 'Opossum's accomplice!' brings the crowd down on you. You reach the broken fence, but a blow throws you onto its splintered stakes. The voices recede as you collapse. Your questions end here.

hideout.title: An invitation with teeth
passages: The old customs house stands beyond the last working well. Its front door is shut, but a wire glints beneath the latch. Opossum apparently dislikes unannounced visitors. Get past his trap and enter the hideout.
Through a split in the wood, you spot a spring-loaded blade behind the latch. Work out how to release the door without releasing the blade.
The side entrance is bricked up. Back at the front door, the wire waits patiently. Find a safer way to deal with it.

outcomes.success: You pin the spring and lift the latch. The blade stays where it belongs. From inside the customs house comes the scrape of a chair, then a frightened voice.
outcomes.failure: The wire tightens. You stop before the blade springs, but the door remains shut. Step back and try another approach.
outcomes.bust: The blade snaps across your arm as you force the latch. You kick the door open, bleeding. Inside, someone pulls a chair into the shadows.

hideout.fatal_outcome: The wire snaps tight as you lift the latch. Opossum's hidden blade strikes deep. You fall across the threshold of the old customs house, and the door creaks shut against your boot. The hunt ends at his abandoned hideout.

captive.title: A knife and a name
passages: A young Criollo woman sits bound to a chair, a torn red scarf around her neck. 'Did Opossum send you?' she asks. You cut her bonds, but keep your distance. Convince her she can trust you.
She backs toward the empty hearth, clutching her freed wrists. Tell her why you are following Opossum, and give her room to believe it.
Her eyes flick between you and the doorway. Lower your voice. You need her story, and she needs a reason to feel safe.

outcomes.success: She gives her name: Inés. Opossum kidnapped her, and she overheard him arguing about a debt to Elias Drywell, a Yankee farmer. 'Drywell knows where he went.' You leave her free, with water and a clear road back to the settlement, and head for the farm.
outcomes.failure: She shakes her head and retreats behind the chair. Whatever she knows stays with her for now. Try reassuring her another way.
outcomes.bust: She snatches a knife from the table and stabs you before bolting through the door. 'You're all the same! You, Opossum, Elias Drywell!' she shouts. You bind the wound. Drywell's name is painted on the farm sign you passed outside the settlement. Time to ask him some questions.

captive.fatal_outcome: She snatches the knife from the table and strikes before you can pull away. You collapse beside the overturned chair. She flees through the doorway, leaving the knife where it fell. Your hunt ends in Opossum's abandoned hideout.

farmer.title: The farmer keeps accounts
passages: Elias Drywell watches you approach his dusty farm, one hand resting on a long gun. His ledger is open on a barrel. Ask about Opossum, and convince him that giving you directions is better than adding another enemy to his accounts.
Drywell shuts the ledger. 'Never heard the name.' His finger stays between two pages. Find a better way to ask about the debt.
The farmer spits into the dust. 'Everybody wants something.' Explain what he stands to gain if you find Opossum.

outcomes.success: Drywell taps the ledger. 'Old tannery. Malopasso. Bring him trouble, and perhaps he'll remember what he owes.' Before you can leave, smoke curls beneath the storehouse door. Someone inside starts shouting.
outcomes.failure: Drywell denies everything and tells you to leave. His eyes drift toward Malopasso. Step back and try another approach.
outcomes.bust: Drywell fires before you can finish. The shot wounds you, and you dive behind a wall. 'Tell your friend at the old Malopasso tannery I'm done paying!' he shouts. Then he lowers the gun: smoke is rising from his storehouse, and someone is trapped inside.

farmer.fatal_outcome: Drywell raises the long gun before you can finish your question. The shot knocks you down beside the farm wall. His voice carries on above you, then fades. You die in the dust of a debt that was never yours.

fire.title: The burning ledger
passages: Flames lick the storehouse door. A figure runs toward Malopasso, leaving an oil tin in the dust: Opossum's people have come to settle Drywell's accounts. A farmhand coughs behind the barred window. Get them out.
Smoke drives you from the doorway. The farmhand pounds on the window frame. Look for a way to open it from outside.
The front entrance is lost in smoke, but a low loading hatch stands beside the wall. Find a safer way to reach the trapped farmhand.

outcomes.success: You force the window and pull the farmhand into the open. 'The canal bridge,' they gasp. 'Quickest way into Malopasso. Go before they warn him.' Behind you, Drywell watches his accounts turn to ash.
outcomes.failure: The heat forces you back before you can reach them. The farmhand is still calling. Find another entrance and try again.
outcomes.bust: You get the farmhand through the hatch, but a falling beam catches you on the way out. Wounded, you stagger clear. 'Take the canal bridge into Malopasso,' they tell you between coughs. Opossum has left enough fire behind him.

fire.fatal_outcome: You push the farmhand through the hatch, but the burning roof gives way before you can follow. A beam pins you beneath the flames. Outside, someone calls your name. You do not answer.

canal.title: Water under a broken bridge
passages: A dry irrigation canal cuts across the road to Malopasso. The bridge still stands, which is more than can be said for several of its planks. Cross before the sun sinks behind the city walls.
One plank crumbles beneath your testing boot. The canal bed below is a jumble of broken stone. Find a sounder crossing.
A narrow support beam reaches the far bank. It offers little room for doubt. Choose your footing and try again.

outcomes.success: You reach the far bank as the bridge creaks its objections. Ahead, Malopasso's empty windows catch the low sun. Then a voice calls from beneath a collapsed house: 'Don't walk away. Please.'
outcomes.failure: The bridge shifts before you commit your weight. You retreat to solid ground. Search for another way across.
outcomes.bust: A plank gives way. You catch the far edge and haul yourself onto the bank, wounded by broken timber. Before you can move on, a voice calls from a collapsed house beside the road. Someone else is having a worse afternoon.

canal.fatal_outcome: The bridge breaks beneath you. Your grip slips from the far edge, and you fall onto the broken stone below. The canal has been dry for years. At its bottom, your trail ends.

rubble.title: A voice beneath the stones
passages: A scavenger lies pinned beneath a timber in the collapsed house. A bag of salvaged hinges rests just beyond their fingers. 'I know these streets,' they say. 'Get me out and I'll get you through them.' Free them.
The timber will not lift cleanly. Loose stones slide from the wall above it. Look for something you can use as a lever.
The scavenger points toward an iron bar under the broken stairs. Find a way to shift the weight without bringing the rest of the house down.

outcomes.success: You lever the timber aside. The scavenger crawls free and leads you through a sheltered lane toward the tannery district. 'Mind the lookout,' they whisper. 'Those two mastiffs aren't ornaments.'
outcomes.failure: The rubble shifts, but the timber stays put. The scavenger clenches their teeth. Set it down safely and try a different angle.
outcomes.bust: The timber slips as you lift it, crushing your hand against the stone. The scavenger scrambles clear and helps bind the wound. They show you a sheltered approach to the tannery lookout. 'Two mastiffs,' they warn. 'Let the handler do the talking.'

rubble.fatal_outcome: The timber shifts as you lift it. You push the scavenger clear, but the weight comes down on you with the rest of the wall. The stones settle. No footsteps follow yours out of the collapsed house.

lookout.title: A toll paid in teeth
passages: At the entrance to the tannery district, a lookout holds two enormous mastiffs on fraying leads. 'Opossum pays me to keep this street quiet. Give me a reason to disappoint him.' Convince the handler to let you pass.
The mastiffs lean into their leads, watching your hands. Their handler waits for a better offer. Try a different argument from beyond their reach.
One dog growls; the other saves its breath. The lookout has not moved. Find the words that will open this street.

outcomes.success: The lookout considers your argument, then draws the mastiffs aside. You pass under three suspicious gazes and slip through the tannery gate.
outcomes.failure: The dogs block your approach, growling. You retreat beyond their reach. The handler still listens, so try another approach.
outcomes.bust: A lead slips. One mastiff sinks its teeth into you before you scramble through a broken gate. You slam it behind you, wounded but inside the tannery district.

lookout.fatal_outcome: The lead slips. One mastiff knocks you down while the other closes its jaws. The handler hauls at the fraying ropes, too late. You die outside the tannery gate, with Opossum still beyond it.

tracking.title: The abandoned tannery
passages: The tannery smells of dry leather and old rot. Fresh bootprints cut through the dust between empty vats. Follow Opossum's trail to the rear of the building.
The footprints disappear beneath fallen shelves. Search the drying room for a fresh scrape or a disturbed patch of dust.
A shutter bangs above the empty vats. One trail leads to a bricked-up doorway; another runs beneath a hanging sheet of hide. Find the route Opossum used.

outcomes.success: The footprints lead to the rear passage. Beyond it, Opossum looks up from a loaded handcart. Your eyes meet. He kicks away the wheel chock, and the cart starts rolling toward you.
outcomes.failure: The tracks lead into a room with no other exit. Opossum doubled back. Return to the vats and search another part of the tannery.
outcomes.bust: Rotten flooring collapses beneath you. You climb out wounded beside the rear passage. Opossum hears the crash and turns. He kicks a loaded handcart down the slope toward you. Apparently the floor was only the first objection.

tracking.fatal_outcome: The tannery floor gives way. You fall through rotten boards into the stone-lined vat below. Above you, dust drifts through the hole. Opossum's footprints continue toward the rear passage; yours stop here.

cart.title: The last warning
passages: A handcart loaded with tanning stones gathers speed down the sloping passage. Opossum runs for the alley behind it. Get out of its path and cut off his escape.
You shelter in a doorway as the cart smashes into the passage wall. Opossum is beyond the wreckage. Find a way around before he slips away.
Broken wheels and loose stones block the rear passage. A drying rack offers a route above the wreckage. Reach the alley and corner Opossum.

outcomes.success: You slip past the wreckage and reach the alley ahead of him. Opossum stops short and draws his rusty machete. The low sun drags long shadows along the walls. No more running.
outcomes.failure: The cart blocks the passage, and you cannot get past safely. From the alley comes the scrape of Opossum's boots. Find another way around.
outcomes.bust: The cart clips you and hurls you against the wall. You drag yourself through a broken side door, wounded, and stumble into the alley. Opossum is there, hemmed in by the walls. He raises his machete.

cart.fatal_outcome: The loaded handcart catches you against the passage wall. Stone and timber crash over you, drowning out Opossum's retreating footsteps. The alley lies just beyond the wreckage. You never reach it.

duel.title: No more running
passages: The low sun drags long shadows along the alley walls. Opossum lifts his rusty machete. His face looks like a bad mistake; his intentions look worse. You raise the revolver before he can close the gap. Play your hand.
Opossum slips behind a broken cart, then rushes you with the machete. The alley leaves little room for polite disagreement. Find your opening and keep fighting.
Steel scrapes the wall as Opossum closes in. Dust hangs in the low sunlight. You steady the revolver for another shot. This alley is too narrow for both your futures.

outcomes.success: Your shot ends Opossum's story. His machete clangs against the stones, and he drops dead in the alley dust. You barely have time to breathe: one of his associates heard the gunfire and steps out beneath the ruined arcade.
outcomes.failure: Your shot chips the wall. Opossum pulls back his machete, very much alive and in no mood to discuss it. The duel continues.
outcomes.bust: Opossum's machete catches you before you can pull away. You stagger behind the broken cart, bleeding. He is still coming. The duel continues.

duel.fatal_outcome: Opossum closes the gap before you can bring the revolver around. His rusty machete strikes, and you fall against the alley wall. The low sun drags your shadow across the stones. Opossum steps over it and walks away.

associates.title: The company Opossum kept
passages: One of Opossum's associates steps into the square. Their gun is already drawn. Survive this challenger.
Your opponent ducks behind the dry fountain. Their next shot chips the stone beside you. The same fight is far from settled.
Boots scrape the deserted street as your opponent circles for a better angle. Keep your eye on them and ready your hand.

outcomes.success: The challenger falls. For a moment the square is quiet, but more footsteps echo between the empty buildings.
outcomes.failure: Your shot goes wide. The challenger takes cover, still alive and still aiming at you. The fight continues.
outcomes.bust: The challenger catches you with a shot. You stagger into cover, wounded. Your opponent is still there. The fight continues.

associates.fatal_outcome: The challenger's shot catches you as you leave cover. You fall into the dust of Malopasso, your revolver slipping from your hand. Opossum is dead, but the company he kept has claimed the last word.

death.title: The trail ends here
death.text: Two wounds. Your trail ends here. Try again with a fresh deck and put what you learned to work.

ascension.title: You take the badge
ascension.text: Exactly 21 Reward points. You take the badge. Your name becomes a frontier legend.

exhaustion.title: You survived the hunt
exhaustion.text: The deck has run out. You survived this stretch of the Fronteira. This is a survival ending, not an exact-21 ascension. Try a fresh deck for another tale.

associate_encounters.title: An unpaid account
passages: Opossum's bookkeeper steps from the ruined arcade, revolver drawn. 'He owed me. Now you owe me.' Some accounts refuse to close. Play your hand.
The bookkeeper crouches behind a stone column and fires. Apparently your offer to settle matters has been declined.
A shot tears through a hanging shop sign. The bookkeeper circles the arcade, still determined to collect. Keep fighting.

outcomes.success: The bookkeeper falls behind the column. That account is closed. Elsewhere in the ruins, someone has heard the argument.
outcomes.failure: Your shot strikes the column. The bookkeeper ducks back into cover, alive and still collecting. The fight continues.
outcomes.bust: The bookkeeper's shot catches you. You crawl behind the arcade wall, wounded. The same debt is still being disputed.

associate_encounters.fatal_outcome: The bookkeeper's revolver cracks from behind the column. You fall beneath the ruined arcade, unable to raise your gun again. Somewhere above you, a voice says the account is settled. Malopasso keeps the receipt.

associate_encounters.title: A bad view from above
passages: A rifle barrel slides over the edge of a ruined balcony. One of Opossum's associates has found a better view of the square than you have. Find an opening before they use it.
The rifle cracks from the balcony. You move between the dry fountain and a fallen cart, looking for a clear shot at the same attacker.
Dust puffs from the wall beside you. Above, the rifle barrel shifts to follow. Keep fighting from cover.

outcomes.success: Your shot finds the balcony. The rifle clatters down into the empty square, and its owner does not follow it. For a moment, you can breathe.
outcomes.failure: Stone chips fly from the balcony rail. The rifle disappears, then finds you again. The same shooter is still up there.
outcomes.bust: A rifle shot catches you between cover. You stumble behind the fountain, wounded. The shooter on the balcony is still watching.

associate_encounters.fatal_outcome: The rifle cracks from the balcony before you reach cover. You fall beside the dry fountain. Above the square, the barrel withdraws into shadow. The last thing you see is the empty sky over Malopasso.

associate_encounters.title: Steel at the water trough
passages: An associate rises from behind an empty water trough, a long knife held low. 'That machete belonged to a friend.' They close the distance. Keep them away from your throat.
The knife scrapes the trough as your opponent follows you around it. Find room to raise the revolver.
Your opponent feints left, then darts toward your gun hand. The trough stands between you, for now. Play your hand.

outcomes.success: Your shot stops the knife wielder beside the trough. Their blade lands in the dust. Somewhere beyond the square, boots scrape stone.
outcomes.failure: Your shot goes wide. The knife wielder pulls back behind the trough, waiting for another opening. The fight continues.
outcomes.bust: The knife catches your arm. You wrench free and retreat around the trough, wounded. Your opponent follows, blade still raised.

associate_encounters.fatal_outcome: The knife wielder feints around the trough and gets inside your reach. Steel finds its mark. You sink against the dry stone, your revolver still caught between you. The blade is gone by the time you fall.

associate_encounters.title: The road out is closed
passages: A rider waits beneath Malopasso's broken gate, pistol levelled at your chest. 'Opossum was paying for my horse. Guess who's paying now.' Survive the challenger blocking your way out.
The rider dismounts and takes cover behind the gatepost. You trade shots through the drifting dust.
A bullet punches the old gate beside you. The same rider shifts behind the masonry, searching for a better angle. Keep fighting.

outcomes.success: The rider falls beside the gatepost. The horse bolts into the open road. You are still standing, though Malopasso has more company to offer.
outcomes.failure: Your shot strikes the gatepost. The rider stays behind it, very much alive. You still have to finish this fight.
outcomes.bust: The rider's pistol catches you as you cross the gateway. You fall into cover, wounded. The same challenger still blocks the road.

associate_encounters.fatal_outcome: The rider's pistol flashes beneath the broken gate. You fall across the road out of Malopasso. The horse stamps beside you, impatient to leave. You will not be going with it.

special_completion.title: A tale worth telling
special_completion.text: You did something special: you brought Opossum down and lived to finish the adventure. Malopasso will remember that. The hunter still stands, and the quarry lies in the dust.

duel_completion.title: The perfect last shot
duel_completion.text: Opossum falls, his machete strikes stone, and your tale ends on that final shot. You survived to bring the hunt and the adventure to a close together. That is a finish worthy of a Fronteira legend.

ascension.unfinished: A messenger finds you as the light begins to fail. Opossum has been shot, his accomplices taken into custody. Some of the goods recovered from his hideout might be yours, if you can convince the people keeping the inventory. Your hunt is over. In the Fronteira, that counts as a good ending.
ascension.unfinished_duel: Before the duel can go any further, a shot rings out from the far end of the alley. Opossum falls. Armed riders move past you to take his surviving accomplices into custody. One tells you that recovered goods will be waiting at the settlement. Some might be yours. You lower the revolver. The hunt is over, even if the final shot belonged to somebody else.
ascension.after_opossum: A messenger reaches you with news: Opossum's remaining accomplices have been taken into custody. The shooting is over. His machete will trouble nobody again, and some of the goods recovered from the hideout might still bear your name. You set off to claim what is yours. For once, the Fronteira owes you something.
ascension.on_opossum: Your shot finds Opossum, and his machete clangs against the alley stones. He falls. This time there is no new challenger: riders entering the square cut off his surviving accomplices and take them into custody. The hunt and your adventure end together. Somewhere among the recovered goods, there may be a little of your old life left to reclaim.

exhaustion.unfinished: You have pushed this hunt as far as you can. With nothing left to stake on the next encounter, you break off the pursuit and find a road back to safety. Opossum remains unfinished business. Tonight, getting home alive will have to be enough.
exhaustion.after_opossum: At last, the footsteps stop following you. Opossum is dead, and the associates still standing have lost their appetite for the argument. You leave Malopasso alive, carrying what you managed to keep. The stolen goods can wait for another day. Tonight, the road out is enough.
exhaustion.on_opossum: Opossum falls into the alley dust, his machete ringing once against the stone. You stay on your feet until the echoes fade. The figures beyond the square withdraw into the ruins. You have nothing left to give this hunt, and nothing more to prove to him. You turn toward the road home.
